sentence: What looks like a need to keep gathering is really a fear of the emptiness that would come if you stopped.
What strength is already in you?
It may be a standstill you cannot shift, or a pause in which you see more clearly.
In your personal plans, an unexpected disruption has broken structures you spent months carefully building.
Your knuckles have learned this before your mind has.
What comes from outside can break a plan before anyone has a chance to change it.
You should let this rest before you decide.
Look closer, and you see the one stem that did not break.
Do you kneel at the quiet rim, or walk on toward the roar?
It is time to stop carrying what was never yours.
You stand beneath older birches, where a sapling reaches through their shade.
In your current relationship, external calm has stopped the arguments without resolving the weight sitting between you.
The runes are preparing you for what comes next.
In what you make for others, care may give a small beginning time to take hold, though it may also keep it out of sight.
In your home the talk has gone flat and careful.
Are you protecting your growth, or hiding from judgment?
Can you leave room for what has not shown itself?
You already know which of the two you will choose.
You have been giving more than you get back, and it has worn you down.
If you looked back today, what line would your steps make?
